subject: Request: EmberCore activation safeguards and deterministic rollout plan
messages:
From: Chris Holt <chris.holt@embercore.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com
Cc: sally.lee@embercore.com
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: deterministic rollout and activation safeguards for Redwood API - EmberCore

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for the demo last week — EmberCore is excited about the latency and cost profile you showed. Before we sign, our security and platform teams have two non-negotiable asks for the production pilot (pilot start target: 2026-07-06):

1) Deterministic activation gate: ability to enable/disable the new model per-tenant (and pin a tenant to a model variant) so we can stagger activation and fallback cleanly.
2) Basic audit & telemetry export: per-request trace IDs with an exportable audit log (S3/HTTPS) and a short TTL retention option for the pilot.

These three items are blockers for legal sign-off on the SOW. I attached our short requirements doc (EmberCore_requirements.pdf) with examples. Can you confirm whether Redwood can deliver a scoped implementation (gate + telemetry) within 3 weeks if prioritized? If not, we need an explicit rollout plan with milestones to show our execs.

Chris
Chris Holt
Director, Platform Engineering
EmberCore

Attachment: EmberCore_requirements.pdf
From: karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com
To: jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com, irene_choi@redwoodinference.com, laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Request: deterministic rollout and activation safeguards for Redwood API - EmberCore

Team — forwarding EmberCore's ask (attached). This is a $1.2M ARR pilot -> production path. Legal won't sign without the gating + audit guarantees. High level asks below:

- Tenant-level activation gate + model pinning (minimal UX + API)
- Per-request trace id + exportable audit log (S3) with 90-day retention option for pilot
- Minimal failure mode: automatic fallback to stable model variant if the gated model errors

Can you confirm feasibility and estimate effort? If we can scope to "gating + telemetry + fallback" we might be able to close within two-week engineering runway + one week QA, but we need tradeoffs. Please reply with options (A: full scoped delivery, B: minimal gated rollout) and ETA.

Thanks — I can escalate and reallocate a sprint slot if product/eng need headroom.

— Karthik
Account Exec, Enterprise
Redwood Inference
From: jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com
To: karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com, irene_choi@redwoodinference.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 16 Jun 2026 11:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: deterministic rollout and activation safeguards for Redwood API - EmberCore

Karthik — thanks for the context and the doc. TL;DR: feasible with tradeoffs. Details below.

What we can do (candidate minimal scope):
- Activation flag per-tenant (API + tenant metadata) and model-variant pinning: implement a feature-flagging layer atop routing; low-risk.
- Deterministic fallback: if the active variant fails or exceeds error threshold, route to a pinned fallback.
- Trace IDs + audit export: emit trace id in request logs and add an export job to push deltas to customer S3 on an hourly cadence. This will not be an instant stream but satisfies audit/export requirements.

Engineering estimates (rough):
- Option A (full): gating API + pinning + robust streaming audit + console controls + e2e QA = 4-5 weeks (2 engs + 1 backend PM)
- Option B (scoped): gating API + pinning + hourly S3 export + simple fallback + limited QA = 2.5-3 weeks (1.5 engs + 0.5 PM)

Risk notes: streaming replay / real-time audit is more work (compliance team may ask for synchronous exports), and UI work for console controls adds time. I sketched an approach and attached a small technical sketch (technical_sketch_gating.pdf) that maps APIs and error thresholds.

If Sales can commit to prioritization (we pull a sprint ticket and assign a partial engineer), we can hit the 3-week window for Option B. Otherwise Option A is the safe path but will push past EmberCore's pilot start.

-Jordan
Senior Product Engineer (Runtime)
Redwood Inference

Attachment: technical_sketch_gating.pdf
From: irene_choi@redwoodinference.com
To: karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com, jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com, laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com
Date: Wed, 17 Jun 2026 08:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: EmberCore gating request — options and resource ask

Appreciate the clear ask. Two pragmatic routes we can offer EmberCore:

Option 1 (Conservative) — Full implementation
- Scope: gating + model pinning + near-real-time audit stream + console controls + e2e QA + doc updates
- ETA: 5 weeks from kick (target 2026-07-20)
- Resources: 2 backend engineers (shared), 1 infra engineer (for export infra), 1 PM, 1 QA
- Implication: bumps several sprint commitments; needs product leadership sign-off

Option 2 (Accelerated pilot) — Minimal gated rollout (recommended for deal closure)
- Scope: tenant activation flag + model pinning API + hourly audit export (S3) + deterministic fallback + smoke QA
- ETA: 3 weeks from kick (target 2026-07-06) if we assign 1.5 FTE engineering + 0.5 PM and take an activation slot this sprint
- Implication: lower-functionality admin UX (console still manual), acceptable for pilot with EmberCore if they accept hourly audit cadence

Operational asks for Option 2:
1) Sales to route priority and commit to a kickoff by 2026-06-22 (so we can start this sprint).
2) Legal to sign a narrow amendment to SOW covering the pilot gating scope (I attached a draft SOW link).

Links: HubSpot deal - https://app.hubspot.com/deals/EMB-2026-042
SOW draft - https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1EmberCoreSOWDraft

I can own the engineering plan and weekly checkpoints if Sales secures the kickoff. If we go Option 2, we should also add a rollback runbook and SLA note into the SOW.

— Irene
Head of Product Operations
Redwood Inference

Team + EmberCore — thanks for the fast turnaround. EmberCore has signaled urgency and can accept the hourly audit cadence for the pilot as long as we provide the rollback runbook. They want kickoff this sprint.

Decision: proceed with Option 2 (Accelerated pilot).
